environment: Hermes Native headless Rust tests and pinned-source comparison; no live Gateway or installed Windows UI was used.
notes: Focused older_transcript filter passes five tests: accessible earlier-page control; offset page profile and latest-order receipt validation; mismatched-profile rejection; backend-order rejection; and boundary-overlap deduplication. Native loads offset-based older pages. Pinned Desktop uses an around-row request anchored to the previous prompt, fences the latest request despite ineffective cancellation, and checks page contiguity when a long turn separates the page from the anchor. Native prompt-predecessor navigation and around-window replacement are not implemented; live Gateway behavior, physical Windows interaction, and source-paired acceptance remain open. Capability is partial.
